proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8209 compares Prakrit pi(v)aï, Hindi pīnā, Gujarati pīvũ and Marathi piṇẽ. These selected imperative/infinitive forms continue the drinking stem; pī-l- completives and ambiguous bare past forms are excluded.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6141 derives regional de- from Middle Indo-Aryan dēti/dēi, remodeled with imperative dēhi and the ‘take’ paradigm. The bare imperative belongs here; diyā and doubled de-de are excluded from this proposal.
